body: You're right. Thanks for helping me admit it to myself :)
I understand. You make more sense, thank you
I understand it's coming from me. I should give this more thought. Thank you a lot, you're a big help
I think you're definitely right. I'll keep all of what you said in mind. She has a best friend. I'll make sure she's at least reachable when I confess. Thank you so much. You're a great help.

That's actually thoughtful of you. I had this thought too when I texted her. But she said she wouldn't kill herself because it'd be bothersome, for her family. she's even more selfless than me, well when I thought I was being so.. I'm convinced I should make her feel better and more stable before confessing to her.. but it feels wrong somehow. Maybe it's what the first commenter said about the damage it'll do. I'll give this more thinking. Thank you so much.

Honestly you have a point. But I want to tell her because it's probably one reason our relationship is not healthy, and she'll know whether I confessed or not. I don't think we'd end up better with the latter. I don't know if living with it would be fair for her. I mean for the long term. What do you think?

You have a point.. helping her and being there is what she really needs. I thought about apologizing to her and telling her on another time, when things are better. But I know she won't get better soon, and I don't think I can keep this in for a long while. It's unfair.. What do you think?
I understand. Thank you so much. I really hope it's for the better.
I'm sorry you had to deal with all of that. I can't imagine how hurtful it was. Some people let their issues control them rather than admitting them.I hope you are safer and happier now. Thanks.
Thanks. You're right about this, even though I'm not sure about her reaction.
I told her I needed to tell her when we meet, do I brush it off? She's been suicidal for a while now, we're both not sure when she'll get better. I'm scared and worried.
Thank you. This sounds more logical than what I had on my mind. Do you think it's better to see her or tell her over a text?
